name: Unchecked Expansion
summary: Wharfmaster Whizzbuzz says the Eastsea pirates north of here are a greater threat than those you fought before. Their raid left Windstead burned, and he wants their advance inland stopped.

sections.title: Windstead in Ashes
sections.body: Windstead lies burned after the Eastsea pirates ransacked it and carried off its plunder. Wharfmaster Whizzbuzz asks you to thin the ranks of the raiders and bombardiers north of here. He fears the pirates may push their turf farther inland.

faq.q: Who asks for help against the Eastsea pirates?
faq.answer: Wharfmaster Whizzbuzz asks you to thin the Eastsea pirates' ranks.
The Eastsea pirates ransacked Windstead, took its plunder, and burned it to the ground.
Wharfmaster Whizzbuzz names Eastsea Raiders and Eastsea Bombardiers as the pirates to thin.

faq.q: Why does Whizzbuzz want their ranks thinned?
faq.answer: He wants to stop the pirates from pushing their turf farther inland.
